chapter: Cincinnati, Buffalo, Russell and Fletcher Henderson
title: How long he stayed with Henderson
summary: He stayed two to four years, then went to the Russell band after Armstrong took it over.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: How long did you stay with Fletcher Henderson?
Was that '31, '32, two years, three years?
Two or three years, something like that.
When you left him you went with -
She knows better than I do.
That's when you went with Louis, because I was keeping up with them because they were usually playing Cleveland at least once in that time.
So he traveled with that band for a while?
Did he do any recordings with the band as a whole?
With Fletcher? I've got the whole album of that. John Hammond gave it to me, the whole album.
So then you went from there to Louis Armstrong, or back with Louis Russell?
Lou Russell and from Lou Russell - it was still Russell's band but Louis Armstrong took over.
You say you played with Fletcher Henderson for about 4 years?
Three or four years, something like that.
